summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with former and current directors to settle unpaid board compensation. The company issued 89,430 common shares at $1.62 per share, satisfying $144,876.71 of outstanding debt after a partial cash payment. The transaction was approved by disinterested directors and the audit committee under Nevada law and Nasdaq rules. Shares were issued in reliance on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing is a routine debt-for-equity settlement, not a transformative special situation; no risk-arb angle exists.
